snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Switch & PS5 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
After seeing rocking success on PC, mobile, and Xbox, the dwarves of Hoxxes IV are expanding their territory, giving even more workers a chance to join the Company. Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is coming to PlayStation 5 on October 7th and Nintendo Switch 1 & 2 on October 9th. 

Wishlist for the Switch:
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/deep-rock-galactic-survivor-switch/

Wishlist for PlayStation 5:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019431

Developed by Funday Games
Published by Ghost Ship Publishing

Find out more:
https://www.fundaygames.dk/drgs
